hints.title: Circular Array Step Geometry
hints.text: Moving in a circular array of size n allows forward steps and backward steps.

hints.title: Shortest Step Metric
hints.text: The shortest distance between index i and startIndex is min(abs(i - startIndex), n - abs(i - startIndex)).

hints.title: Scan All Matches
hints.text: Iterate over all occurrences of target in words and minimize the circular distance.

hints.title: Circular Distance Evaluation Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass computing direct and wrap-around circular distances.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No simulation of cyclic step loops is required when direct modular distance can be computed.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses min(abs(diff), n - abs(diff)) for circular shortest path calculation.
